issues.legal_issue: A sale deed executed before a creditor’s suit and attachment gives the vendee rights protected against that attachment when the deed is registered afterward.
material_facts: The vendors executed a sale deed in favour of the purchaser on 9 September 1970.
The creditor filed a money-recovery suit against the vendors on 13 September 1970 and obtained attachment before judgment of the property on 17 September 1970.
The sale deed was registered on 26 October 1970, after the attachment.
The purchaser claimed the property under the sale deed, and the creditor later obtained a decree in the money suit.
issues.conclusion: The purchaser’s rights took effect from the date the sale deed was executed once it was registered, and were protected against the later attachment. Because the sale preceded the creditor’s suit, it could not be treated as a transaction made to obstruct or delay execution of a decree. The appeal was allowed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 47 of the Registration Act provides that a registered document operates from the time it would have operated had registration not been required or made. Read with Order 38 rule 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure, it protects a vendee whose sale deed was executed before attachment, even where registration occurred afterward. A transaction predating the suit cannot be said to have been made with the intention of obstructing or delaying execution of a decree. The court distinguished Ram Saran Lal v. Mst. Domini Kuer, Hiralal Agrawal v. Rampadarath Singh, Radhakishan L. Toshniwal v. Shridhar, and Bishan Singh v. Khazan Singh; referred to Vannarakkal Kallalathil Sreedharan v. Chandratnaath Balakrishan, Tilakdhari Singh v. Gour Narain, and Raja Ram v. Giraj Kishore; and approved Faiyazauddin Khan v. Mst. Zahur Bibi, Champat Rao Mahadeo v. Mahadeo Baijirao Kunbi, and Kalyanasundaram Pillai v. Karuppa Mooppanar.

predicates.attachment_before_judgment_proceeding: A creditor sought attachment of property in a proceeding to recover a debt before obtaining judgment.
predicates.sale_deed_executed_before_suit: The property owners and the vendee executed a sale deed before the creditor filed the debt-recovery suit.
predicates.registration_completed_after_attachment: The sale deed was registered after the creditor obtained attachment of the property.

issues.definition: When a creditor seeks attachment before judgment and a sale deed was executed before the suit but registered only after attachment, the vendee’s rights precede the attachment.
